name: Jair
bio: This Jair was a Gileadite who judged Israel for twenty-two years after Tola — sharing his name, generations apart, with the earlier descendant of Manasseh who, in the time of Moses, captured several small towns in Gilead and named them Havvoth Jair. He had thirty sons, each riding his own donkey, and controlled thirty towns that were still called Havvoth Jair at the time Judges was written, located in the land of Gilead. Jair died and was buried in Kamon (Judges 10:3-5).
